result:
Clean. All 617 existing tests pass and typecheck succeeds. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/config/constants.ts`** — `MAX_SUB_ISSUE_DEPTH`
- **`src/lib/issue-hierarchy.ts`** (new) — `IssueHierarchyError` plus pure tree helpers (`descendantsOf`, `subtreeHeight`, `levelOf`, `wouldCycle`, `rollupOf`)
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`** — maps `IssueHierarchyError` to `conflict`, recognized by `isDomainError`
- **`src/types/issue.ts`** — `IssueRollup`
- **`src/schemas/issue.ts`** — `setIssueParentSchema`/`SetIssueParentInput`
- **`src/types/notification.ts`**, **`src/schemas/notification.ts`**, **`src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`**, and the preferences-form label map — new `sub_issues_completed` kind
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`** — `setIssueParent`, `listSubIssues`, `listIssueTree`, `getIssueRollup`, `listLiveDescendantIds`
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`** — `setIssueParent`, `listSubIssues`, `getIssueRollup`; `createIssue` validates a given parent (same project, live, depth); `archiveIssue` cascades to live descendants top-down, each with its own `issue.archived` event
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** — fan-out on `issue.status_changed`/`issue.archived` that tells a parent's assignee once its sub-issue tree has no open issue left, skipping self-notification, archived/unassigned/no-sub-issue parents, and non-closing transitions

No existing tests encoded behavior this change contradicts, so none needed edits — all 617 pass unchanged, and I verified the new behavior (depth/cycle guards, rollups, ordering, and cascade-silence for notifications) with a throwaway test before deleting it.
